name: IIS - Performance Trends
description: The IIS - Performance Trends Dashboard provides details on ISS infrastructure trends for requests, active connections, bytes received and sent, files received and sent, queue size, arrival rate, and cache hit rate.
title: IIS - Performance Trends

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/iis* webserver_system=iis webserver_farm={{webserver_farm}} Win32_PerfFormattedData_W3SVC_WebService CurrentConnections | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as iis_log_message
| parse field=iis_log_message "Name = \"*\";" as Name
| parse field=iis_log_message "CurrentConnections = *;" as CurrentConnections
| timeslice 1m
| sum(CurrentConnections) by _timeslice, Name
| transpose row _timeslice column Name

_sourceCategory = Labs/iis* webserver_system=iis webserver_farm={{webserver_farm}} Win32_PerfFormattedData_W3SVC_WebService TotalMethodRequestsPersec | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as iis_log_message
| parse field=iis_log_message "Name = \"*\";" as Name
| parse field=iis_log_message "TotalMethodRequestsPersec = *;" as TotalMethodRequestsPersec
| timeslice 1m
